biggest_catch: This is demand-response money, not a rebate for buying a thermostat: you earn the rewards by letting Consumers Energy adjust your thermostat on hot summer days (June–September). No smart thermostat on central AC, no enrollment.
catches: Must be a Consumers Energy residential electric or combined electric + natural gas customer.
Requires a qualifying smart thermostat controlling central air conditioning.
Rewards come as gift cards: up to $125 off a new thermostat or a $50 gift card for enrolling an existing one, plus a $25 gift card after each participating summer.
The $25 summer gift card requires staying enrolled through the cooling season.
Peak events run June–September; you can override adjustments but participation drives the reward.

steps: Confirm you're a Consumers Energy residential electric or combined electric + natural gas customer.
Get a qualifying smart thermostat on your central AC — or enroll the one you already have.
Enroll in Smart Thermostat Rewards on the Consumers Energy page: up to $125 off a new thermostat or a $50 gift card for an existing one.
Allow small automatic adjustments on hot summer peak days (June–September).
Receive a $25 gift card after each summer you stay enrolled.
